title: Legacy Transfer applications
description: Application identities accessing AWS Transfer Family endpoints through the custom identity provider.

applications.description: Transfer Family application identities, keyed by the username presented when connecting to an SFTP or FTPS endpoint.

application.description: Configuration for one application identity using the custom identity provider.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of the application identity.

owner.description: Free-text name of the team, service or organisation responsible for the identity.

enabled.description: Whether Terraform should provision this identity in the current environment.

expires_on.description: Optional review or expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format. This is recorded for governance but is not currently enforced by Terraform.

identity_provider_key.description: Key of the custom identity provider configuration stored in DynamoDB. Use secrets for credentials held in Secrets Manager.

idp_username.description: Username passed to the selected identity provider and used to look up credentials in Secrets Manager. The custom IdP delimiter @@ is not permitted.

home_directory_prefix.description: Bucket-relative prefix mapped to the identity's logical root directory. Do not include a leading slash or wildcard; access includes all objects beneath this prefix.

server_id_allow_list.description: Transfer Family server IDs on which this identity may authenticate. An empty list permits any Transfer server using this identity provider.

cidr_blocks.description: IPv4 CIDR blocks permitted by both the Transfer endpoint security group and custom identity provider. An empty list creates no ingress rule for this identity.

ssh_public_keys.description: SSH public keys stored in the identity's Secrets Manager secret for passwordless SFTP authentication. Private keys and passwords must never be committed; Terraform creates a null password entry for optional manual population.

prefix.description: An S3 bucket-relative prefix without a leading slash, trailing slash or wildcard.

example-application.description: Example application uploading files for processing
